authorization: User requested applying profit protection and multiple tests on the existing demo EA.
entry_strategy: unchanged M1 channel20; BUY and SELL mirrored
activation: Observed executable gross profit >= max(0.5 * original entry-to-SL risk, 2 * cost-price reserve + 2 ticks)
floor: max(50% of highest observed executable gross profit, cost-price reserve + 1 tick)
reserve_note: Fixed extra execution reserve, not a guarantee of realized net profit; include known entry charges twice and negative accrued swap in addition.
decision_clock: fresh symbol quote, at most once per timer second; BUY uses Bid, SELL uses Ask
stop: Only tighten, retain original TP, respect tick grid, stops/freeze constraints, require broker readback
floor_breach: After activation, request an early market close if current executable price breaches the recorded profit floor; retain SL during failed requests and retry with bounded frequency
structure_exit: Not enabled: no validated causal structure definition or MTF module exists in this EA. Profit-floor breach supplies the implemented reversal protection.
recovery: Persist original SL/TP, observed peak, accepted SL and requested close per position. Preserve existing account/day risk state and recovery-close policy.
scope: One existing owned demo position at a time, no added entry attempts or partial closes

verification_seams.policy: Shared production planner: activation, monotonic floor, mirrored Bid/Ask and broker distances; cannot prove broker fills.
verification_seams.journal: Native durable record: corruption, restart and identity isolation; cannot guarantee operating-system survival of hardware failure.
verification_seams.execution: Native tester uses the production manager against CTrade and broker-model positions; generated historical ticks do not establish real fills or profitability.
verification_seams.deployment: Native compilation, original policy regressions, installed-source hashes, preserved day budget, fresh demo status; does not forecast trading returns.

evaluation: Keep this one declared setting. Report failures and early exits that miss later TP; do not optimize thresholds against the reviewed single execution-check trade.

entry_contract.timeframe: M1 only; explicit PERIOD_M1, independent of displayed chart
entry_contract.signal: Midpoint close of last complete bar strictly above previous 20 midpoint highs: BUY; below previous 20 midpoint lows: SELL; equal: no entry
entry_contract.atr: Simple mean of 14 midpoint true ranges from completed quote-derived bars
entry_contract.stop_distance: D=max(2*ATR,0.50); BUY SL=entry Bid-D, SELL SL=entry Ask+D
entry_contract.target: BUY TP=entry Bid+3D; SELL TP=entry Ask-3D
entry_contract.risk_check: Both signal-close nominal estimate and actual entry-side OrderCalcProfit must fit; initial loss must be negative
entry_contract.freshness: New completed M1 only; entry within first 10 seconds after close, symbol quote <=3 seconds old; no startup/catch-up entries
entry_contract.one_position: Any account position/order blocks new entry; owned magic/identity validated before management
entry_contract.day_boundary: UTC+8 Malaysia; rollover only when flat and reconciled; fatal halt never reset
entry_contract.r_reporting: signed (actual exit-actual fill)/original D; cost-inclusive broker P/L reported separately
entry_contract.session: Current broker schedule; no entry in last120sec; flatten in close buffer; Friday no entry>=19UTC and flatten>=20UTC
entry_contract.holidays: Dec24-26, Jan1, US Thanksgiving, Good Friday
entry_contract.one_time_execution_check: Previously consumed; not rearmed and excluded from strategy qualification
entry_contract.clock: Observed broker offset per session must be UTC+2 or UTC+3 and synchronized; full historical clock/session metadata required

qualification_contract.baseline: Matched BUY/SELL counts; same profit protection, quote eligibility, session/day/position envelope; independent random schedules
qualification_contract.data_required: Validated Bid/Ask ticks or adequate quote sequence to reproduce one-second management, plus broker price/volume grid, stops/freeze, costs, clocks/sessions and missing-data coverage
qualification_contract.sensitivity: Cost/spread, execution delay, missing-quote and same-bar order diagnostics; diagnostics cannot select a winning replacement candidate
qualification_contract.holdout: Do not access for qualification until a matching in-sample freeze exists. Previously consumed 2026 history is not fresh evidence. New prospective capture is not automatically a qualifying holdout.
qualification_contract.step8: Requires Steps6+7 and >=95% agreement of actual strategy trade lists against independent reference on identical broker quotes. Alternating fixture entries are excluded.
qualification_contract.search_history: At least82 prior registered historical strategy variants; M1 ports/protection cannot inherit an earlier numerical pass or pretend to be the first search.
